sssd_domains.description: List of SSSD domain names to configure. Each name must match a domain section.

sssd_debug_level.description: Global SSSD debug verbosity (0–9). Higher values generate more logs.

sssd_default_domain_suffix.description: Suffix to append to short usernames if no realm is provided (e.g., 'example.com'). Leave empty to disable.

sssd_reconnection_retries.description: Number of times SSSD retries connecting to IPA servers before giving up.

sssd_services.description: List of SSSD services to enable. Common: 'nss' (name resolution), 'pam' (auth), 'ssh', 'sudo', 'ifp'.

domains.description: List of domain configurations (one per IPA domain). Each entry defines an IPA domain.

name.description: Domain name (e.g., 'example.com' or 'idm.example.com'). Must match the section name.

ipa_servers.description: List of IPA server hostnames or IP addresses. Must include at least one server.

fallback_homedir.description: Path template for user home directories (supports %u for username, %d for domain).

cache_credentials.description: Enable credential caching for offline authentication (requires secure storage).

ipa_dyndns_update.description: If true, SSSD updates the client’s DNS A/AAAA record in IPA DNS (requires proper permissions).

ldap_search_base.description: LDAP search base for fallback LDAP lookups. Use IPA’s directory base (e.g., 'cn=accounts,dc=example,dc=com').

chpass_provider.description: Optional. Set to 'ipa' to enable IPA-based password changes via PAM.

allow_groups.description: List of IPA groups allowed access (via access_provider).

deny_groups.description: List of IPA groups explicitly denied access.

allow_users.description: List of IPA users allowed access.

deny_users.description: List of IPA users explicitly denied access.

enumerate.description: Enable enumeration of users/groups (may impact performance on large directories).
